summary: B109: 3 of the 5 GNU-as idioms now assemble with LLVM (p.mul; p.lb/lbu/lh/lhu/lw/sb/sh/sw imm(rs) and (rs) without '!'; .func/.endfunc). The other 2 are left as SDK edits on purpose: .weak followed by .global (upstream rejects it deliberately, 8f8b5e5587c3, generic MCELFStreamer.cpp) and %tiny (GAP-private relocations 59/60 that clash with upstream numbers; needs an owner decision, B105/B110).

files.llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVInstrInfoXpul: insn-tablegen (InstAliases, placed after the instruction defs, away from LOOPsetup/F028)

per_idiom.p.mul: PULP alias (binutils Xpulpv2 row, MATCH_MUL; GNU gates on Xpulpv2 only). Implemented as InstAlias -> MUL.
per_idiom.p.lX/p.sX imm(rs) without !: PULP alias (binutils 'd,o(s)'/'t,q(s)' rows with base MATCH_L*/S*). Implemented as InstAlias -> LB..SW, plus (rs) zero-offset forms. GNU emits plain lw/sw; same bytes.
per_idiom..func/.endfunc: Generic GNU-as STABS directive, no-op without --gstabs; never implemented upstream (not a deliberate rejection). Implemented in RISCVAsmParser as a no-op with GNU's pairing diagnostics, only when +xpulpv.
per_idiom..weak then .global: Generic; deliberately rejected upstream since 8f8b5e5587c3 [MC] Error for .globl/.local which change the symbol binding and warn for .weak (D90108). Not changed (generic file, upstream design). SDK edit: put .weak after the .global.
per_idiom.%tiny: GAP binutils: absolute address in the 12-bit immediate, R_RISCV_12_I(59) for loads / R_RISCV_12_S(60) for stores; GNU ld accepts sym in [0,0x7FF], 'relocation truncated to fit' otherwise. 59/60 are upstream R_RISCV_PLT32/SET_ULEB128; the fork's RISCV.def already reserves R_RISCV_12_I/12_S as 68/69 but nothing emits them. Not implemented: needs a relocation-number/lld interop decision. SDK-side %tiny->%lo gives identical bytes for the SDK's symbols (range check lost).

verification.probe: all aliases + existing PULP forms byte-identical to GNU as; out-of-range offsets rejected like GNU; RV64 rejects

known_differences: LLVM compresses the base instruction an alias expands to when registers allow (p.lw a0,0(a1) -> c.lw); GNU as 2.28 does not compress the p. spelling. No SDK use is affected (no compressible registers).
proposed_test: llvm/test/MC/RISCV/xpulp/xpulp-gnu-aliases.s: RUN llvm-mc -triple=riscv32 -mattr=+xpulpv -show-encoding, CHECK p.lw/p.lh/p.lhu/p.lb/p.lbu imm(rs) and (rs) -> lw/lh/.. with base encodings, p.sw/p.sh/p.sb -> sw/sh/sb, p.mul -> mul [0x33,0x85,0xc5,0x02]; unchanged encodings for p.lw 4(t0!) / t0(t1) / t0(t1!). Error test (not): p.lw a0, 2048(a1) out of range; RV64 'requires RV32I'; without +xpulpv p.mul unrecognized. Directive test: .func a / .endfunc / .func c, lab / .endfunc accepted with no output; nested .func -> '.endfunc missing for previous .func'; stray .endfunc -> 'missing .func'; without +xpulpv -> 'unknown directive'.
